_readme: OWCS stream/VOD sources for the video computer-vision pipeline.
Each entry points the pipeline at ONE broadcast video for ONE match. It
only says WHERE the video is and WHICH broadcast layout to read it with.
It never contains hero comps and is never used to infer comps.
Comps come only from the video CV (source='cv') or manual corrections
(source='manual'). FACEIT supplies the match/map structure that a video
entry pairs to via 'match' (internal id) or 'faceitMatchId'. If the paired
match is not in the DB yet (run FACEIT ingest first), the entry is skipped
with a message — the pipeline never invents a match from a video source.
Resolution order for the video, most-preferred first:
fixtureFrames  -> a committed folder of pre-extracted PNG frames
(offline/demo/CI; no yt-dlp, no ffmpeg, no network)
localFile      -> a local .mp4 on disk (dev; needs ffmpeg only)
vodUrl         -> a stream/VOD URL fetched with yt-dlp (production)
YouTube VOD sources (platform='youtube') are long broadcast streams and
are sampled BY TIMESTAMP with pipeline/video_ingest.py --source <id>. Only
a ~2s section around each sample offset is fetched, so a 6-hour VOD is
never fully downloaded. Fields: id, title, url, platform, date, region,
notes, enabled, sampleIntervalSeconds, layout. These are ingestion-only
until a later step pairs their frames to a FACEIT match/map.
This file is committed so GitHub Actions can run without secrets.

PLACEHOLDER ENTRIES ARE NOT ALLOWED HERE. A 'REPLACE_WITH_...' row used to sit in this list; it could never resolve to a real match or VOD, it made every dry-run report a phantom skipped source, and it invited someone to fill in half of it. Add a source only once its match exists in the DB and its layout is calibrated. Enforced by pipeline/test_release_reproducibility.py.

sources.notes: Self-contained offline demo. Synthetic frames + fixture templates; proves ingest->filter->detect->snapshots without any network or real VOD.

sources.title: OWCS broadcast VOD (AfCXDIMPsLE)
sources.notes: ~6h OWCS stream. Ingestion/frame-extraction only for now; comps and FACEIT pairing come later. Preview with: video_ingest.py --source owcs-afcxdimpsle --dry-run (needs yt-dlp + network). Then sample a window, e.g. --start 1:30:00 --end 1:45:00 --sample-interval 60. Fill in real date once known.

sources.title: OWCS — Crazy Raccoon vs ZETA DIVISION (8C105lNzLAM)
sources.notes: PRIMARY real-VOD calibration target. Reference frame at t=0:06:06 (366s) shows a clean live HUD: Crazy Raccoon (left) vs ZETA DIVISION (right), all 10 hero portraits visible. Test: run_owcs_auto.py --source owcs-8c105lnzlam --start 0:06:00 --end 0:06:40 --every 10 --fast --force. Ingestion/frame-extraction + layout calibration only for now; comps come later via CV evidence + review, never from FACEIT.

sources.title: OWCS 2026 | NA/EMEA | Stage 2 Playoffs Day 3 (nD5lLLWDkY0)
sources.notes: CALIBRATED and REUSABLE. 9h28m broadcast, many matches. The map-pick/intro card runs to ~0:40:25; live gameplay is up by ~0:40:30. Calibration window 0:41:00-0:41:30 (Twisted Minds vs Geekay Esports, Control, First to 3): 30/30 hero crops, 3/3 frames pass the gameplay filter. The anchor is the broadcast chyron ('OWCS 2026 | STAGE 2 | PLAYOFFS'), deliberately chosen to be match/map/mode/score INVARIANT, so layouts/owcs_nd5lllwdky0.json is reusable for every match in this VOD and for other VODs from the same production -- verified on a second unrelated match at ~2:04:00 (Escort, 1-2). It correctly rejects intro cards, post-event graphics and REPLAYS (a replay renders a full HUD showing a PAST comp). Note --fast caps the window to 30s, so 'start 0:40:00 --fast' samples only intro frames and honestly reports 0 crops; use 0:41:00 for a window that lands on gameplay. Smoke test: run_owcs_auto.py --source owcs-nd5lllwdky0 --start 0:41:00 --end 0:41:40 --every 10 --fast --force. Only the 640x360 progressive format section-downloads for this VOD (DASH formats stall/403), so --height 1080 still yields 640x360 and the report says so. Hero templates not harvested yet; detection stays honestly 'skipped'.

sources.title: Crazy Raccoon vs ZETA Division — OWCS Korea Stage 2 Grand Final (POV)
sources.notes: Player-POV upload. Calibrate the ObsSojourn top-bar layout ONCE (layouts/obssojourn_pov.json), then reuse for every video from this channel. Map windows come from the description; multiple POVs of one match share signature crazyraccoon--zetadivision--2026-07-12 and must merge, not duplicate.
sources.disabledReason: layouts/obssojourn_pov.json has never been calibrated, so this source was registered ahead of its layout and every run stops at preflight with 'layout not found'. To enable it, calibrate the layout once (docs/INGEST-CR-ZETA-KRGF.md): python pipeline/calibrate_source.py --clip work/clips/krgf.mp4 --times 120,400,900,1500,2000,3000 --source-id owcs-is7ehd0nf84 --out layouts/obssojourn_pov.json — then set enabled back to true.
